baseline.title: Detailed faces · baseline colours
baseline.scenePrompt: Use image 1 as the identity reference for Vaan Astra. Preserve his face and permanent traits; the current story appearance controls hair, clothes and pose. Use image 2 as the identity reference for Astra Elysia. Preserve her face and permanent traits; the current scene appearance controls clothes and pose. Vaan turns toward Astra in startled recognition as she stands in the open bedroom doorway. Characters: Vaan Astra, one clean-shaven young adult man, violet hair and golden eyes in this life, black and gold tailored coat and white gloves; Astra Elysia, one adult woman, long black hair, black tailored clothes and feathered mantle. Exactly these two people. Camera: tight chest-up two-shot, slightly low angle. Both heads and shoulders fill the frame; Vaan foreground left, Astra at the doorway right. Show both faces at readable three-quarter angles, with clear eyes and cheek structure. Crop out lower bodies and most furniture. Faces are the focal point, not the room. Location: the existing luxurious bedroom, silk-covered four-poster bed, battle tapestries, stained-glass windows, reddish-brown desk and velvet armchair. Lighting: amber window light models their faces and clothing, with cooler blue sky notes outside the windows. Facial rendering priority: detailed drawn upper and lower eyelid contours, defined inner eye corners, clearly separated irises and pupils, expressive brow muscles, a shaped nose bridge and nostril planes, defined lips and mouth corners, layered cel midtones on the cheekbones, under the nose and beneath the jaw. Use purposeful fine ink and age-appropriate expression creases, not smooth blank face patches. Vaan is startled, with raised brows and slight tension around his eyes and mouth; Astra has an intent, controlled expression with defined lids and brows. Keep their reference identities and youthful adult facial proportions. No artificial aging, deep old-age wrinkles or photographic pores. Preserve the original full-colour manhwa drawing style and baseline warm skin colours. visualReview.method: Side-by-side inspection of both raw outputs; baseline also inspected at full 1280x720.
visualReview.observations: Both outputs retain two main characters in the bedroom, with larger faces and more pronounced brow/eye/nose shading than the earlier wide examples. The camera is closer, but neither fully obeys the requested chest-up crop. The fantasy-colour version has a clearly cooler, darker teal/blue-violet environment than the amber baseline; it is a stronger comparison and not a claim of the final preferred amount. Pose, clothing and furniture details also shift between these independent generations. Vaan gains a conspicuous earring not explicitly requested. Fine facial detail is still stylized, so the target match remains for the user to judge.
